title: November 2026 Cumulative Updates for Dynamics 365 Business Central
summary: Microsoft released November 2026 cumulative updates for Dynamics 365 Business Central across versions 29.1, 28.7, and 27.13. Online customers will automatically upgrade to version 29.1 and should verify compatibility with their customizations before applying updates.
key_points: Three cumulative updates released in November 2026 for different on-premises versions
Online customers automatically upgrade to version 29.1 with email notification
Organizations should confirm implementation readiness and work with partners before upgrading
Compatibility with custom modifications must be verified prior to applying updates

quotes.text: Online customers will automatically be upgraded to version 29.1 over the coming days/weeks and should receive an email notification when upgraded.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the automatic upgrade process for cloud customers and when to expect the change

quotes.text: Before applying the updates, you should confirm that your implementation is ready for the upgrade and ensure compatibility with your modifications.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the critical prerequisite step organizations must take before upgrading to avoid breaking custom functionality
